items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Later on we did that European tour where Lennie played either with the Connie Kay duo, or solo, and I was playing with Bill Evans.

ctx.x: I never got the impression that Lennie really wanted to have a working band. Is that a fair statement?

At that point I thought he did. Then I realized that [it] was too difficult for him to move around even with his boys. Later on we did that European tour where Lennie played either with the Connie Kay duo, or solo, and I was playing with Bill Evans.
